name: Facet Tinyquill
description: Open with a salute that doubles as a guard, the point and free palm covering two lines at once.

name: Honed Probe
description: Jab down the line drawn between the two courts, the point travelling flat and straight.

name: Granite Needlerod
description: Step twice to the same side on an even count, the second step landing as the first lifts.

name: Rumble Slimshaft
description: Tap the opponent's wrist on the same side as your own, mirroring the strike to break his rhythm.

name: Hollowrodtip
description: Thrust and return along the same line so cleanly that the point is back before a counter lands.

name: Murkrodtip
description: Receive a cut on the free palm and the blade together, then turn it past the shoulder.

name: Gustseam
description: Walk a small circle around the opponent's lead foot, the point always facing him.

name: Vengeful Spikeguard
description: Thread the point through the gap between both of the opponent's arms and drive qi into the chest behind them.

name: Unbowed Hairpoint
description: Turn aside a strike with the free hand and echo it back at the same spot with the stiletto.

name: Facetthread
description: Strike one point twice in a single beat, the first stab parting the cloth and the second carrying the full qi charge through it.

name: Ironreed
description: Fold the free arm across the chest like a wing and hold the blade back along the hip.

name: Forged Rodbase
description: Rise from a crouch with the point leading, jabbing upward as the legs straighten.

name: Verity Waxgrip
description: Glance upward and then down the line of the opponent's shoulder to find the opening a hawk would choose.

name: Reedruin
description: Drop the full body weight behind a downward thrust, the point falling like a hawk from height.

name: Mastering Stitch
description: Seize the weapon forearm in the free hand like a talon and pin it to the chest with the point.

name: Torrential Pin
description: Beat the arms once and spring backward three paces, landing in a ready crouch.

name: Nova Thread
description: Strike from directly above the opponent's sightline, the point arriving before the shadow of the arm.

name: Silt Rodtip
description: Kick off the target after the stab, rise clear of the counter, and fall again from the opposite angle.

name: Phantom Nova Seam
description: Blur from a risen stance into a dive that spans the whole guard distance, the point landing ahead of the sound.

name: Thorn Tinyquill
description: Stand with a hollow between blade arm and guard arm, qi ready to run down either.

name: Eviscerating Triprism
description: Probe the opponent's left side with a light stab along the guard-hand track.

name: Corroding Boltpoint
description: Probe the opponent's right side along the blade-hand track, a hand's breadth from the first.

name: Phantom Rodbase
description: Withdraw into the hollow of the stance by sliding the lead foot back beside the rear.

name: Vitalreed
description: Switch the breath so the qi that fed the guard arm now feeds the blade arm.

name: Iron Hairpoint
description: Cross the two tracks at the opponent's ribs, so the stab arrives from an angle he did not guard.

name: Torrent Rodtip
description: Let a strike pass through the hollow between the arms and glance off the blade's flat.

name: Ponderous Boltpoint
description: Draw the opponent's weapon arm along the free-hand track until the elbow locks and the guard opens.

name: Rumble Stitch
description: Drill the point in with a twist of the wrist, qi boring a hollow channel through the guard.

name: Numbing Needlerod
description: Stab a joint on each track and flood both with qi, sealing the limb's movement for several breaths.

name: Spikeguard Devastation
description: Draw both qi tracks into the point and loose one thrust that pierces deeper than either track alone could drive.

name: Hoarfrost Waxgrip
description: Plant the feet wide and low, the knees bent like the rim of a basin around the body's centre.

name: Unbudging Slimshaft
description: Hold the stiletto flat and still at belt height as if balancing a full cup upon it.

name: Decimating Thread
description: Prick lightly at the hollow of the throat, testing the guard without committing the weight.

name: Might Probe
description: Spill sideways from the stance in one flowing step when the opponent's rush grows too strong.

name: Vitalrodtip
description: Press the soles into the ground and draw qi up from the earth into the legs.

name: Facetdarn
description: Lean in with a steadily growing push of qi, the point sinking deeper the longer it is held.

name: Indomitable Triprism
description: Scoop an incoming blade low and carry it down into the ground away from the body.

name: Granite Pin
description: Retreat by sinking and sliding the weight back slowly, drawing the opponent into overreach.

name: Probe Fortitude
description: Pin the opponent's sleeve with a stab and hold it until his struggle goes still like a pool.

name: Tempered Pin
description: Let gathered qi swell up through the legs and spine and out through a single piercing stab.

name: Ponderous Needlerod
description: Spill a flurry of pricks over the opponent's guard like water over a brimming rim, driving him back.

name: Facetreed
description: Draw qi down into the legs like water into a basin, then release it up the arm in one stab that pierces layered guards.

name: Ghosting Seam
description: Enter the opponent's space at a gentle angle, widening toward him like a river mouth.

name: Proberuin
description: Thrust along a gentle downward line like a stream running down a slope.

name: Facet Rodbase
description: Stand firm with the blade planted at the front like a bank turning the current aside.

name: Tempered Seam
description: Match the opponent's pace for three steps, then stab in the gap between his footfalls.

name: Gust Slimshaft
description: Spin the blade in a small eddy that catches a cut and carries it round and away.

name: Lightning Spikeguard
description: Hop across the opponent's line in two quick steps like a traveller crossing a ford.

name: Darn Havoc
description: Flow the point through a gap in the guard as water runs between stones, qi carrying it deep.

name: Maiming Tinyquill
description: Pull the weapon wrist down and back in a sudden undertow while the point pins the sleeve.

name: Honed Darn
description: Surge through the opponent's guard in one flowing rush, the point entering as the current passes.

name: Flintlike Hairpoint
description: Hold a guard in each hand, the left high at the face and the stiletto low at the ribs.

name: Rumble Darn
description: Open the exchange with a tiny prick to the back of the hand, just to draw blood and attention.

name: Waxgrip Mettle
description: Check the opponent's weapon hand with the free palm before it can finish its swing.

name: Granite Triprism
description: Advance with both feet moving in matched short steps so the guard never opens.

name: Pinblink
description: Step back right after each prick so the blade returns to guard on the same beat.

name: Rumble Boltpoint
description: Prick the guarding forearm three times in one spot until the arm lowers by reflex.

name: Impenetrable Boltpoint
description: Slip a blow through the gap between guard hand and blade, letting it pass beside the ribs.

name: Stitchhavoc
description: Circle the opponent with matched steps, pricking the same flank at each turn of the circle.

name: Hoarfrost Rodtip
description: Tug one sleeve with the guard hand and pin the other with the point to hold the stance still.

name: Probewrath
description: Parry with the free hand and stab with the blade at the same instant, as one paired motion.

name: Forged Thread
description: Toss the stiletto between hands mid-burst so the pricks arrive from alternating sides.

name: Hairpoint Wrath
description: Pour a cascade of pricks over the arms and face so the opponent can do nothing but guard.

name: Deed Slimshaft
description: Pin the weapon shoulder and wrist with paired qi-laden pricks, locking the arm against any swing for a long moment.

name: Rodtipspine
description: Stand with the feet braced against the wind and the blade held low and forward as sworn.

name: Facet Probe
description: Jab like a puff of wind, quick and flat, and be gone before the arm can answer.

name: Pin Glimmer
description: Step aside without turning the shoulders, keeping the bearing on the opponent unchanged.

name: Rodbase Premonition
description: Hold the breath on the oath's last word and steady the arm before the thrust is loosed.

name: Rodtipwrath
description: Run a thread of qi along the held bearing and pierce at its far end.

name: Evergreen Spikeguard
description: Swat the opposing blade away with the stiletto's side as a gust sweeps a leaf aside.

name: Threadblink
description: Cut backward along a line the wind has cleared, keeping the foe's rush upwind of you.

name: Shattering Waxgrip
description: Surge forward on a gust of qi and pierce through the guard before the oath is finished.

name: Thornpin
description: Stab through cloak and sleeve and knot the cloth round the blade so the wind draws it taut.

name: Thread Reckoning
description: Speak the oath, take the bearing and loose one thrust that crosses the guard as quickly as a gale crosses open ground.

name: Triprism Durance
description: Square the shoulders to the opponent and swear silently to keep that bearing whatever comes.

name: Rodtiphavoc
description: Poke along the held bearing at the nearest unguarded hand.

name: Silt Seam
description: Sidestep without breaking the line, as if both feet ran along rails.

name: Mayhem Tinyquill
description: Press the open palm against the opponent's weapon forearm to stall his stroke.

name: Might Slimshaft
description: Breathe slowly in time with a wind that does not shift, keeping the hand calm.

name: Iron Boltpoint
description: Follow the opponent's retreating guard along the bearing and pierce where it drops.

name: Inexorable Hairpoint
description: Turn the guard from side to side while keeping the point on the sworn line.

name: Ghosting Stitch
description: Drift into close range on the wind's push, unseen behind the opponent's own cloak.

name: Nova Darn
description: Thread the point along the sworn bearing between two parries and into the ribs.

name: Hourpin
description: Loose a run of pricks along the bearing to break the opponent's footing without leaving the line.

name: Grim Spikeguard
description: Hold the sworn bearing through feint, shove and blow, then drive one qi-charged stab straight down it.

name: Awlvalor
description: Stand with the blade low under an open sky, offering no corner for a foe to pin you into.

name: Rumbleawl
description: Jab across a wide gap with the wind at the shoulder, covering ground in one lunge.

name: Gust Probe
description: Step along the edge of the foe's reach, never in, never far, as the wind brushes a rim.

name: Darnruin
description: Lunge the full length of the body across open ground with a pulse of qi in the rear heel.

name: Gust Tinyquill
description: Raise the blade along the skyline of the opponent's cut and tip it over your shoulder.

name: Reedglare
description: Circle ever wider round the foe where nothing blocks the path, drawing him to turn and tire.

name: Forged Seam
description: Sprint across the open with the point leading, qi gathering as speed rises, and pierce at full run.

name: Gyvethread
description: Pin the opponent's cloak to the earth with a thrown-down stab so he cannot turn away.

name: Unseen Rumble Thread
description: Cross the whole open ground in a single blink of motion and place the point where the guard was.

name: Awlspine
description: Extend the blade arm full length on the bearing and hold it there as a measuring rod.

name: Needlerod Scourge
description: Jab from the very edge of reach, the shoulder rolling out to add a finger's length.

name: Stitch Whirlpool
description: Keep the gap constant by matching the opponent's every step and no more.

name: Iron Rodtip
description: Snap the extended point back to the chest line the moment the jab has landed or failed.

name: Waning Triprism
description: Glance past the opponent's shoulder at a distant mark to confirm the bearing has not drifted.

name: Rumble Pin
description: Extend until the last knuckle of the sword hand and thrust along the bearing a pace farther than expected.

name: Chimereed
description: Cross the opposing blade's bearing with a small arc and drive it off the line.

name: Gust Needlerod
description: Shift the bearing a quarter turn in one sliding step, so the point comes at the foe from a new side.

name: Thorn Stitch
description: Anchor the point in the opponent's belt or strap, holding him to the bearing at full arm's length.

name: Ironseam
description: Stretch the thrust along the bearing with qi in arm and point, piercing past a guard before it closes.

name: Intentrodtip
description: Drive a quick rain of pricks down the bearing from the edge of reach, never letting the foe close.

name: Tempered Hairpoint
description: Throw the whole body and a burst of qi along the bearing so the point lands beyond any ordinary reach.

name: Thorn Waxgrip
description: Stand at an imagined plateau edge with weight forward, the blade arm held loose against the draft.

name: Hellish Rodbase
description: Jab at a single speck of the opponent's coat and let the crosswind hold the line.

name: Dazzling Rodtip
description: Step along a narrow ridge line with the edge of the foot, balanced against the gust.

name: Needlerod Vigil
description: Breathe with the updraft that climbs the cliff and let it lift and steady the sword arm.

name: Rodtipscourge
description: Rush across level ground and prick the opponent's weapon hand at the end of the run.

name: Chime Boltpoint
description: Turn the blade into the draft that rises off the ridge so it pushes the opposing cut away.

name: Vanishing Triprism
description: Drop backward off a ledge or step with a rolled landing, leaving the opponent with empty air.

name: Ironprobe
description: Hold the point on one speck through a full gale, then release a qi-charged thrust along that line.

name: Unseen Pin
description: Slant into the opponent's space on the crosswind and stab as the gust takes his cloak.

name: Punishing Seam
description: Fix the point on a single speck and drive through it with the whole plateau wind and a full qi charge.

name: Slimshaft Tenacity
description: Raise the stiletto to the brow in salute, then lower it into a low, forward guard.

name: Tempered Waxgrip
description: Jab once with the whole of the sworn word behind the point, no wasted motion.

name: Might Spikeguard
description: Advance one pace and plant the foot as if driving an oath-stake into the ground.

name: Might Darn
description: Ease backward on slack knees when the wind drops, to keep the gap without hurry.

name: Daybreak Rodtip
description: Settle the fingers around the grip as around a promise, firm without trembling.

name: Tempered Tinyquill
description: Send a thread of qi down the blade on a gale-quick stab that is already home when the foe flinches.

name: Equipoise Triprism
description: Turn the covering arm outward as sworn, taking a cut on the forearm bracer while the point stays aimed.

name: Suffocating Thread
description: Pin a trailing sleeve or sash and let the wind pull the opponent against the blade.

name: Siltprobe
description: Slide round the foe on a circle whose centre is his lead foot, the bearing never leaving him.

name: Rumble Probe
description: Skewer through a covering arm and into the chest behind with a qi-driven thrust carried by the wind.

name: Nova Spikeguard
description: Pierce twice in the same breath, the second stab riding the first's gap as the oath is spoken.

name: Mangling Boltpoint
description: Whirl a storm of quick pricks round the foe's guard until his feet give ground.

name: Booming Facet Needlerod
description: Spend every sworn word and breath on one last thrust, the qi gathered whole into the point.
